name: Main
notes: Drag the top card and let go, or tap ✕ and ♥. Card is one layer repeated once per place; Swipe Card decides what each copy does, and each copy reads the one above it. The Knobs tab (⌘5) holds the feel, and ⌘' flips between Proposal and the locked Shipped app.

props.text: We only suggest places with photos you can see. Try more places, another area or activity.

inputs.item1: Photos: Arnold Gatilao · Eugene Kim · John Liu

comments.text: HOW TO READ THIS · Card is one layer, repeated once per place in PLACES · Drag Card and Throw Card → Swipe Card (open it for one card's logic) → Card · each copy reads the card above it · the feel is in the Knobs tab (⌘5), and ⌘' flips between Proposal and the locked Shipped app
BUTTONS · ✕ ♥ shrink while pressed · their taps and holds reach every card, and only the top card acts · Find more places brings the deck back
THE CARD ABOVE · each copy reads copy index − 1, one frame late · the top card has none, so Fallback says it's gone and fully lifted
CATEGORY CHIPS · scroll sideways (the design import added this)
DECK EMPTY · with every card gone, ✕ ♥ dim to 40% as in the app · with Card Flies Out off, End of Deck waits until then
PLACES · one Loop Builder per field, one row per card, top card first · add a row to every builder to add a place
THE DECK · Repeat makes one Card per place, index × −1 puts row 0 on top · Drag Card and Throw Card → Swipe Card (open it) → Card
